## Problem and resulting behaviour

Describe the user or contributor problem and the change.

## Validation

List checks actually completed and any material limitations. For model-dependent work, identify the tested provider/model separately from deterministic checks.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] Scope matches an issue or discussed proposal.
- [ ] Public contract changes have an architecture decision.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and changelog are updated.
- [ ] Behaviour changes have meaningful regression coverage.
- [ ] Contributions and assets can be included under the documented licenses.
- [ ] No secrets or private data are included.
